problem: The hooks log the full text of every grep-like Bash command and its description (detect_grep_usage.py writes `command` and `description` to grep_usage.jsonl) and every pyeye call's `tool_input` (track_mcp_call.py writes it to mcp_calls.jsonl). Commands and arguments can carry paths, search strings or secrets, so the absolute claim is not true.
replacement: - Data is logged locally only: the JSONL files keep the full Bash command (and its description) of each detected search and the arguments of each pyeye call, so review them before sharing
subject: No sensitive information is logged

problem: The setup script needs `jq` to keep existing settings: without it, it replaces `~/.claude/settings.json` with the hooks alone (after a backup). Even with `jq` it sets the whole `hooks` key, so any hooks the user already has are dropped. The page gives neither prerequisite nor warning.
replacement: Add before the code block: "The setup script needs `jq` to keep your other settings; without it, it replaces `~/.claude/settings.json` with the monitoring hooks (a timestamped backup is made first). Either way it replaces your whole `hooks` section, so re-add any hooks of your own from the backup."
subject: bash scripts/claude_hooks/setup_mcp_monitoring.sh

problem: Re-running the setup script is advised as safe because it backs up settings, but the re-run replaces the whole `hooks` key (and, without `jq`, the whole settings file), so any hooks the user added since are lost unless restored from the backup. "copies the hook matchers ... into" reads as a merge.
replacement: once; it backs up your settings first, then replaces your whole `hooks` section (and, without `jq`, the whole file), so restore any hooks of your own from the backup afterwards.
subject: once; it backs up your settings first.

problem: The manual steps never say where the hooks come from: the source is `scripts/claude_hooks/hooks.json`, whose top-level `hooks` object is what goes into settings.json.
replacement: # Copy the "hooks" object from scripts/claude_hooks/hooks.json into ~/.claude/settings.json (requires manual JSON merge)
subject: # Add hooks to settings.json (requires manual JSON merge)
